premises.text: Priorities come from email, mind, and meetings and must be captured in one place before good decisions
premises.evidence_span: your inbox has priorities, but so do they come out of your mind, and they come out of meetings. You have to get them all in one place

premises.text: The Handle habit requires capture, triage, plan, and do because email clients or task managers alone cannot solve priority work
premises.evidence_span: email clients have not been able to solve this problem alone, and task managers have not been able to solve this problem alone

premises.text: Mobile capture and a keyboard handlebar enable fast intent-to-action triage of email and tasks
premises.evidence_span: we've created a unique element we call the handlebar

premises.text: A priority list ordered by importance, with snooze and calendar blocking, structures the plan step
premises.evidence_span: Handle's priority list is ordered by importance with must dos at the top

premises.text: Opening a task shows instructions, comments, links, and the related email thread so work proceeds without context switching
premises.evidence_span: I can jump in and be productive immediately. No context switching

domains.name: handlebar triage and priority planning product

value.text: People finish their must-do priorities that day and protect personal life from email chaos
value.evidence_span: getting all the must do things you have to do done that day

causal_links.evidence_span: we started from scratch. And we built the whole thing
